Crime Busters.name: Crime Busters
Crime Busters.summary: Crime Busters is an Action game, developed and published by Bit Corp., which was released in Asia in 1989. It was also released in Brazil, for the Phantom System NES clone.

Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade.name: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade.summary: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade is a video game for the NES based on the 1989 action and adventure movie of the same name. In the game, the player controls protagonist Indiana Jones, going through levels taken directly from the film, albeit with a shortened and simplified plot.

Sqoon.name: Sqoon
Sqoon.summary: Sqoon is a side-scrolling shooter game published in 1986 by Irem for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

WWF WrestleMania.name: WWF Wrestlemania
WWF WrestleMania.summary: First WWF game to be published on 8-bit and 16-bit gaming platforms
